The '''Timja system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained a group of [[Star/Legends|stars]] known as the [[Timja Suns]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Timja system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-8.<ref name="TEA" />
